The child half of E3-L3-T6's leak fixture holds thinking of its own, so that a
verdict about it is a verdict about a real ledger rather than about an empty
directory, and so the document-frequency statistics the matcher computes have
more than one entry to be computed over.

Nothing in this ledger shares vocabulary with the plan the leak test runs. That
is deliberate: it makes the exit code the leak test observes attributable to
what crossed the boundary and to nothing local.
